We first generated 200 sets of trials ... by resampling the original data with replacement.' The bootstrap is the procedure run; `bias` is not what it is measured as. A STATISTICAL TEST IS NOT AN OPERATIONALISATION OF ANYTHING. It is applied TO measurements; it does not constitute one. On this schema `operationalised-as` names a measurement or definition OF THE FROM ENDPOINT, so a test name in the `from` slot asserts that the test is measured by the other term. meta-claude, 2026-08-15, and MEASURED BEFORE BUILDING: five live edges carry a test name at an endpoint, all five are `operationalised-as`, and ALL FOUR WITH THE TEST IN THE `from` SLOT ARE WRONG. span.label: Posterior parietal cortex encodes the running value of the accumulated evidence as a graded quantity, through a map that does not change over the course of the trial.

span.label: The frontal orienting fields instead encode mainly the sign of the accumulator, splitting activity into two clusters corresponding to the two available choices.

span.label: The FOF tuning curve was significantly steeper at the zero-crossing than the PPC tuning curve, quantifying the graded-versus-categorical distinction.

span.label: Clicks influenced FOF firing about 100 ms earlier than PPC firing, suggesting sensory input reaches FOF by a route that does not pass through PPC.

span.label: Silencing FOF across the whole trial produced a significant bias toward choices on the same side as the inactivation.

span.label: Among four 500-ms inactivation windows, only silencing at the very end of the stimulus changed behavior; silencing during early accumulation did not.

span.label: The same end-of-stimulus specificity held with 250-ms windows: shifting the perturbation just 250 ms earlier abolished the effect.

span.label: Model comparison favored a bias applied after categorization over biases acting on the accumulation process itself.
